deliverables.description: A set of charts or graphs that communicates the selected data analysis results clearly and accurately using appropriate titles, labels, legends, scales, and annotations.

information_nodes.description: The quantitative results and supporting variables from the completed data analysis that are to be visualized.
The stated purpose, audience, key message, and any presentation constraints for the requested visual representations.
Determine which analysis results, comparisons, and patterns are relevant to the requested purpose and should be communicated visually.
Define the chart types, source fields, axes, scales, groupings, color use, labels, legends, and annotations needed to represent the selected results accurately and clearly.
Check that scales, aggregations, labels, and visual encodings preserve the data's magnitudes and comparisons without distortion, and adjust the visual specification as needed.

work_objective: Create graphs, charts, or other visual representations that accurately convey the results of a data analysis to the intended audience.
